Here's a complete HTML/CSS page for a photo gallery with evenly sized thumbnails. It uses CSS Grid and object-fit to keep every tile square and aligned, with a hover zoom and caption overlay. ```html Photo Gallery

Photo Gallery

A small collection of favourite moments.

  • Sunrise Peaks
  • Still Water
  • Autumn Trail
  • City Lights
  • Golden Dunes
  • Rocky Shore
  • Winter Pines
  • Stone Bridge
  • Wildflowers

  • Open Plains
